title: build(deps): patch security advisories in packages/*
body:
Layer 9 of a stacked dependency upgrade. Stacked on #7579.

Clears the GHSA advisories `pnpm audit` reports against the **published packages** and their test dependencies.

`@hey-api/openapi-ts` needs a bump for its own advisory too, but it regenerates ~120 committed fixtures — that's split into #7586 so it doesn't bury these five one-line changes.

| package | from | to | advisory needs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `undici` | ^8.0.0 | ^8.10.2 | >=8.9.0 |
| `ws` | ^8.0.0 | ^8.21.3 | >=8.21.0 |
| `devalue` | ^5.0.0 | ^5.9.2 | >=5.8.1 |
| `valibot` | 1.3.1 | ^1.5.0 | >=1.4.2 |
| `fastify` | ^5.0.0 | ^5.12.4 | >=5.8.5 |

### Two knock-on changes

**1. The fastify version had to be unified across the workspace.**
`@fastify/websocket` → ^11.3.0 and `fastify-plugin` → ^6.0.0 (which 11.3 requires). More subtly, `www` and `examples/fastify-server` also move to `^5.12.4` — they were lockfile-pinned to 5.8.3, and **two fastify copies break `@fastify/websocket`'s `declare module 'fastify'` augmentation**: it binds to the other copy, so `{ websocket: true }` stopped type-checking in the adapter:

```
error TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties,
and 'websocket' does not exist in type 'RouteShorthandOptions<…>'
```

Both of those workspaces needed the fastify bump for their own advisories anyway.

**2. `standalone.http2.test.ts` uses `undici.fetch` for its 404 check** instead of the global `fetch`. The server speaks h2 only, and only the undici instance configured at the top of that file has an `allowH2` dispatcher. It worked before because `setGlobalDispatcher` leaked into Node's bundled undici through a shared global symbol; undici 8.10 no longer does, so on CI the request negotiated http/1.1 and the handshake failed with `ERR_SSL_TLSV1_ALERT_NO_APPLICATION_PROTOCOL`.

### Verification
`pnpm build`, `typecheck-packages`, `typecheck-www`, `monotest-build`, `lint` (42/42) and `manypkg check` all pass. `pnpm test` is 1130/1131 — only the pre-existing `httpSubscriptionLink.memory.test.ts` WeakRef/GC failure. The openapi suite is 176/176.
